experiment: corrected-dataset-fix (MF3: single-objective training on corrected data)
description: Trains RNN/LSTM/Transformer/Mamba on the corrected modular-arithmetic-simple training set (languages/modular-arithmetic-simple-fixed) under the 'rec+lm+ns' objective, 10 trials each (40 runs). Per-trial hyperparameter sampling matches train_and_evaluate.bash exactly. Evaluated on both the standard FLaRe test set and the corrected test set. Also includes the EXISTING standard-FLaRe-trained checkpoints for this same objective, evaluated on the corrected test set (no retraining), for direct comparison.
